title: Prescribed Fourier approximation
statement: For a natural number $n$, a finite family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and a Boolean function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, define its prescribed Fourier approximation as the function $x\mapsto\sum_{a\in\{-1,1\}^n} f(a)K_{\mathcal F}(a,x)$, where $K_{\mathcal F}$ is the prescribed Fourier kernel.
hypotheses_covered: A finite family of subsets of Fin n
A Boolean function from the cube to the signs
